class TestCommandDefinition:
    '''
        CLI subcommand metadata definition for generating GoogleTest unit test file.

        It defines:

            :methods:
                | name - Returns command name.
                | help_text - Returns command help text.
                | options - Returns sequence of command options.
                | __str__ - Returns string representation of definition.
    '''

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        '''
            Returns command name.
        '''
        return 'test'

    @property
    def help_text(self) -> str:
        '''
            Returns command help text.
        '''
        return 'Generate GoogleTest C++ unit test file for interface'

    @property
    def options(self) -> Sequence[OptionData]:
        '''
            Returns command options.
        '''
        return [
            OptionData(
                name='--interface',
                help_text='Path to C++ interface header file (.h / .hpp)',
                action=None,
                default=None,
                required=True,
                choices=None,
                nargs=None
            ),
            OptionData(
                name='--output',
                help_text='Output directory for generated test file',
                action=None,
                default='./tests',
                required=False,
                choices=None,
                nargs=None
            ),
            OptionData(
                name='--prefix',
                help_text='Include path prefix for interface header',
                action=None,
                default='',
                required=False,
                choices=None,
                nargs=None
            ),
            OptionData(
                name='--name',
                help_text='Specific interface name if file contains multiple',
                action=None,
                default=None,
                required=False,
                choices=None,
                nargs=None
            )
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        '''
            Returns string representation of definition.
        '''
        return to_str(self)
